checks.finding: Only trusted Python HostPolicy supplies ceilings. Ordinary CLI defaults stay 100000 operations and 30000 ms; command flags supply caller reductions. A requested increase cannot grant host authority. Discovery reports defaults, actual ceilings and policy identity separately.

Entry admission precedes body evaluation. ExecutionConstructionBudget reads and charges the admitted ledger, preserving the original start and cumulative operations. Numerical work uses that same ledger directly. The restored ordinary ConstructionBudget class is byte-identical to C072, so legacy layout and native admission are preserved without adding a property or new instance field.

Explicit .7 profile/target selection and Agent exclusion remain. The top-level export_targets dictionary is exactly the original six descriptors by AST literal comparison and canonical hash. GLB/0.7 discovery is separately described under execution_budget_interface.export_targets. Existing default command selection remains unchanged.

The direct runtime wraps host cancellation in a BaseException carrier and rethrows the original object. It cannot become a successful or structured product-failure result through ordinary diagnostic translators. The final-result probe preserved exception identity and diagnostic bytes after export/readback had passed, with no returned artifact. Low-level callback restoration uses a boundary marker/traceback snapshot so a stale callback does not replace a later ordinary error.

Failure returns no artifact bytes. A returned valid-prefix descriptor comes only from established evaluate_prefix state; if a stage raises before that prefix is returned, the receipt makes no retained-prefix claim. No durable Agent revision or run state is edited.

Receipts bind source/program/implementation/profile/destination and budget authority, limits, consumption, elapsed time, stage and terminal outcome. Successful result traversal is charged and followed by a final checkpoint. Exhausted product allowance permits bounded failure transport only. Adding CLI path fields is followed by a separate bounded transport encoding check.

The new writer stages complete bytes for both destinations before replacements. Handled second-publication failure restored old files or prior absence in all four destination-existence combinations, with no temporary files left. Recovery backups are retained and reported if restoration fails. The code/documentation do not claim crash atomicity across two paths.

The corrected acceptance input and after-binding records identify e072906f and its exact runtime files; fresh native/browser and actual visual review records also identify e072906f. The outer full run is still pending and is required to establish the complete interval and inherited gate. No earlier candidate or overlay result is relabeled as an e072 regression pass.

The applied construction source exactly matches the independently reviewed proposal. Its ordinary class matches C072. The new subclass has ledger-only operation/start/tick/report behavior and remains outside the unchanged native guard exact-type/callback admission. The guard source is unchanged from a23. Earlier diagnostic overlay passed 115 inherited tests, and root retained applied focused results; those are not the pending complete successor gate.
